name: Crystal Phoenix Aviary
description: An aviary built from towering crystal trees where phoenix‑like birds of light nest, their feathers refracting the sunrise into prismatic fire.
prompt: Sunrise over a vast aviary: massive transparent crystal trees with faceted branches. Birds made of pure light and fire perch, feathers splitting light into rainbows. Ground covered in reflective quartz sand. Ultra‑detail, high dynamic range, 8k.
caption: Reborn in light, every feather a spectrum. 🔥🦜 #CrystalPhoenixAviary
